# Validation Test Case: TemplateLoader Source Verification

## Input
```json
{
  "file": "repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/session/template-loader.ts",
  "check": "TemplateLoader returns source=\"metabob\" for backend templates"
}
```

## Expected Output
```json
{
  "fileExists": true,
  "sourceMetabob": true,
  "usesTemplateServiceClient": true,
  "hasBootstrapFallback": true
}
```

## Test Description
This test case validates that TemplateLoader returns source="metabob" for backend templates meets the specification requirements for Activity Template Flow via MCP Backend.

## Validation Type
Static code analysis - no LLM required
